authority: Owner-approved G4-07 SRC-15 source ceiling 15s / 2MiB, per-worker 2s; private receipt 0.6 only
status: independently specified source-first synthetic oracle; not CP-02 acceptance or FAT host evidence
source_first_method: Use original sealed same-run SRC-14 mountinfo to bind each eligible mount to the actual fixed-worker invocation; compare timed source loop, actual writer receipts, preserved byte hashes and final canonical limit relations; test unknown or contradictory evidence as failure
scope: Existing 15-second cumulative source-level monotonic timer, including evidence persistence
Actual source-level evidence-writer 2MiB quota across worker calls; use only witnessed omitted bytes
Preserved D-02 canonical v1.0.0 / 41 status-pair vocabulary / fixed commands and privileges
guardrails: Never infer SOURCE deadline from a child timeout alone
Never infer an omitted byte solely from a byte-count equal to the ceiling
Any quota-truncated writer call must stop subsequent mounts
Do not pretend a smaller run-wide quota is the SRC-15 source quota
No false simultaneous clock/bytes witness without independent contemporaneous facts
Fail closed on missing/contradictory writer or source timing facts

cases.given: At least 10 eligible same-run SRC14 mounts; nine successful 0.5s child calls with 1.2s evidence persistence each; next source call attempts after >15 seconds
cases.expect: Exactly nine calls; source:time threshold=15 seconds, monotonic observed >=15; no per-call transport deadline; receipt v0.6, one canonical D-02 CaptureLimit

cases.given: One valid worker call ends before 15s, even if caller has no more candidates
cases.expect: Legacy v0.4; neither fabricated source timer nor omitted bytes

cases.given: One worker times out at its actual 2s ceiling before cumulative 15s
cases.expect: Only call-specific transport deadline; no distinct source-time witness

cases.given: Three distinct same-run mounts, first two each yield 1MiB and third produces nonempty bytes beyond source 2MiB evidence writer quota
cases.expect: Writer source 2MiB/observed 2MiB/positive known omitted bytes and sealed partial third call; no fourth invocation; private v0.6 and one D-02 limit

cases.given: Exactly two 1MiB captures, no third mount and no omitted bytes
cases.expect: No source quota assertion; legacy v0.4

cases.given: Run-wide byte meter limit below source quota, first SRC15 writer truncation
cases.expect: Do not relabel run quota as source quota, preserve partial original; canonical refuses unsupported proof

cases.given: Invented source time: threshold 14/16, observed <15, wrong source scope, timed_out false
cases.expect: Private receipt validation refuses each invalid witness

cases.given: Invented source writer: threshold !=2MiB, observed !=2MiB, zero or absent omitted extent, wrong scope
cases.expect: Private receipt validation refuses each invalid witness

cases.given: Source clock and writer quotas may overlap around a last call
cases.expect: No double-counting, preserve only independently witnessed limits; contradictory evidence remains nonpromotable
